name: Cube Computer

modes.label: Per-second VM sizes (50 GB disk)
modes.note: Per-size hour = calculator compute rate + mandatory 50 GB disk fee spread over 730 h (disk_month: $1.923 .. $7.488 per machine-month; compute_hour keeps the raw compute rate). The disk fee is charged for every month the machine exists, even when stopped, so bursty/short-lived use is under-counted by this hourly spread. Calculator prices embed a vendor subsidy (74% on 2 CPU/4 GB down to 0.2% on 16 CPU/128 GB): flagged promo (end date unpublished). 2 CPU 4 GB / 50 GB disk: Live calculator subsidy 74.36% for this size; excludes mandatory $1.923/machine-month disk. plans.name: Prepaid usage
plans.note: No subscription amount advertised in current calculator; hardware selection and prepaid credit. Starter-credit eligibility/amount unpublished. Access is through the Cube Mac app (GitHub sign-in); no public API and no published concurrency limit.

features.ip_note: Egress IPs and proxies not documented; terminal/SSH machine for coding agents with no managed browser.

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

Rates are derived from public calculator implementation and verified by changing its controls in real Chrome. They are displayed calculator quotes, not a separately documented binding tariff. Raw unsubsidized costs must not be advertised as actual small-size retail prices.
Cube is a Linux cloud computer, not a cloud Mac: the macOS requirement refers to the client application. Fly.io hosts machines per privacy policy; dedicated CPU is vendor terminology.
All estimator modes pin disk to 50 GB. Storage charges are size-dependent, so card storage rate stays null; modes only estimate compute. Disk changes alter the subsidy on both compute and disk.

Public terms/privacy still mention subscriptions; current homepage says prepaid compute and disk. Starter credit amount, region, egress, free pause retention limits and billing increment are unverified. Privacy says machine contents retained until requested deletion, even when subscription lapses.

2026-09-28 (cube.computer): no public API / SDK: machines are created from the Mac app, so fleets (rl, ci) and API-driven presets cannot really use it; concurrency limits unpublished. Terminal / SSH cloud machine for coding agents: no desktop GUI or managed browser (desktop, browser set false).
Mandatory 50 GB disk now included in each size hour (disk_month / 730); billed monthly while the machine exists.
